content: 'Ixaheri niwemama
'Ixaheri niwemama mekanihɨkɨtɨni: Xuweni, Tsimehuni, Rewi, Kura, 'Itsakaxi, Tsawuruni,
Rani, Kutse, Wenikamini, Nepɨtahari, Kahari meta 'Atsexi.
Kura nuiwarimama

Kura niwemama: 'Exi, 'Unani meta Tseraxi. 'Ikɨ meyuhaikame 'uka kananeu tewiyari Tsuhaki niweya hetsie puwarayexei. 'Exi Kura pɨmatɨarieyatɨkai, mɨkɨ Yawé kemɨkatinake pɨtiuyuri, hikɨ Yawé tukarieya pinawairi.
Tamaxi, Kura mu'eya, tɨɨri yuhutame kaniwarayexeiya Kura hetsiemieme: Paretsi meta Tsera. Hikɨ meyunaitɨ Kura meyu'auxɨwime kaniwarayexeiya tɨɨri.
Paretsi niwemama: Ketsiruni meta Kamuri.
Tsera niwemama meyunaitɨ meyu'auxɨwitɨ mepakɨ: Tsimɨri, 'Etani, Hemani, Karikuri meta Raxira.
Karimi nu'aya 'Akaxi
kanayani, tatsɨari mɨkɨ 'axamɨtiuyuri 'Ixaheri hetsiemieme Kakaɨyari 'aitsikaya mɨka'anu'eni naime kememɨteka'unakekai.
'Etani nu'aya 'Atsariyaxi kanayani.
Ketsiruni niwemama: Kerameri, Xamɨ meta Keruwahi.
Xamɨ 'Aminarawi paapaya kanayani, mɨkɨta Nahatsuni paapaya kanayani, Kura nuiwarimama wa'ukiyari matɨa.
Nahatsuni Tsarimuni pupaapayatɨkai, mɨkɨta Puhuxi paapaya patɨa.
Puhuxi 'Uweri paapaya patɨa, mɨkɨta 'Itsahi paapaya patɨa.
Kitsahi nu'aya mexɨakame patɨa 'Eriyáwi, hutarieka mieme 'Awinarawi, hairieka mieme Tsimaha,
naurieka mieme Natanaheri, 'auxɨwirieka mieme Xarahi,
'ataxewirieka mieme 'Utseni, 'atahutarieka mieme Rawiri.
Wa'iwama 'ukari mekatenitetewakaitɨni Tsariwiya meta 'Awikahiri. Tsariwiya niwemama meyuhaikatɨ mekanakɨne: 'Awitsahi, Kuhawi meta 'Atsaheri.
'Awikahiri 'Amatsaha mamaaya kanayani Ketexi matɨa memeyexei 'itsimaheri tewiyari.
Karewi Ketsiruni nu'aya tɨɨri kaniwarayexeiya yu'ɨitama 'Atsuwa meta Kerihuti wahamatɨa. 'Ikɨ niwemama mekanakɨne: Ketsexi, Tsuwawi meta 'Axiruni.
Kepauka 'Atsuwa mumɨ, Karewi 'Epɨrata kaniutiwitɨni, mɨkɨ matɨata yuniwe Kuxi kanayexeiya.
Kuxi 'Urihi paapaya kanayani, mɨkɨta Wetsareri paapaya kanayani.
Kepauka Ketsiruni haika tewiyari wiyari mexeiyakai, Makixi nu'aya kaniutiwitɨni, Karaha paapaya, mɨkɨ matɨa kaneyexeiya yuniwe Tsekuwi.
Tsekuwi Yahixi paapaya kanayani, mɨkɨ xeitewiyari heimana haika kiekariyari katinipinieyatɨkaitɨni Karaha kwieyaritsie.

Peru Ketsuxi meta 'Arami mekaninawairieni Yahixi kiekariteya meta Kenati kiekariteya, metatsiere kiekarite wa'aurie mamanetɨkatei. Naitɨ munawaiyarie kanayani haika tewiyari kiekarite. Mɨkɨ meyunaitɨ Makixi nuiwarimama mepɨhɨkɨtɨkai, Karaha paapaya.
'Arike Ketsiruni 'umɨku Karewi-'Epɨrata mɨrakutewatsie, 'ɨyaya 'Awiyaxi, 'Atsuxi kanayexeiya, mɨkɨta Tekuha paapaya kanayani.
Kerameri niwemama, Ketsiruni matɨarieya, mekanakɨne: matɨarieya Xamɨ, Wuna, 'Ureni, 'Utseni meta 'Ahiyaxi.
Kerameri tawari xeime kaniutiwitɨni, mɨkɨ katinitewakaitɨni 'Atara. Mɨkɨ 'Unami mamaaya kanayani.
Xamɨ niwemama, Kerameri matɨarieya, mekanakɨne: Mahatsi, Kamini meta 'Ekexi.
'Unami niwemama: Tsamahi meta Yara. Tsamahi niwemama: Narawi meta 'Awitsuxi.
'Awitsuxi 'ɨyaya katinitewakaitɨni 'Awikahiri, mɨkɨ hamatɨa 'Akiwani kanayexeiya meta Muriri.
Narawi niwemama: Tsereri meta 'Apahini. Tsereri kaniumɨni tɨɨri kawarayexeiyawetɨ.
'Apahini nu'aya 'Itsi kanayani, 'Itsi nu'aya Tsetsani kanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni, Tsetsani nu'aya 'Akirahi kanayani.
Yara niwemama, Tsamahi 'iwaya, mekanihɨkɨtɨni: Ketexi meta Kunatani. Ketexi kaniumɨni tɨɨri kawarayexeiyawetɨ.
Kunatani niwemama: Pereti meta Tsatsa. 'Ikɨ mekanakɨne Kerameri nuiwarimama.
Tsetsani 'ukitsi pɨkawarayexei 'ukari puwarayexei pɨta, meta xeime 'uki waɨriyarika ti'uximayatame pexeiyakai 'ekipitutanaka Yaxika titewakame.
Mɨkɨ xeime yuniwe kaniwitɨtɨani, mɨkɨ 'Atahi mamaaya kanayani.
'Atahi Natani paapaya kanayani, Natani Tsawari paapaya patɨa,
Tsawari 'Epɨrari pupaapayatɨkai, 'Epɨrari 'Uweri pupaapayatɨkai,
'Uweri Kehu pupaapayatɨkai, Kehu 'Atsariyaxi pupaapayatɨkai,
'Atsariyaxi Heretsi pupaapayatɨkai, Heretsi 'Eratsa pupaapayatɨkai,
'Eratsa Tsitsimahi pupaapayatɨkai, Tsitsimahi Tsaruni pupaapayatɨkai,
Tsaruni Kekamiyaxi pupaapayatɨkai, meta Kekamiyaxi 'Eritsama pupaapayatɨkai.
Karewi nuiwarimama
Karewi niwemama, Kerameri 'iwaya, mekanakɨne: matɨarimieme Metsaha, mɨkɨ Tsipi paapaya matɨa, meta Maretsa, Hewuruni paapaya matɨa.
Hewuruni niwemama: Kure, Tapuhaki, Xekeni metatsiere Tsema.
Tsema Xahami 'ukiyarieya patɨa, mɨkɨta Kuxukuhani paapaya patɨa. Xekeni Tsamahi paapaya patɨa.
Tsamahi Mahuni paapaya patɨa. Mahuni Wetsuxi paapaya patɨa.
'Epa, Karewi ti'uximayatsiriwame 'ɨyayatɨtɨ matɨa, Karani mamaaya kanayani meta Mutsa, Katsetsi meta. Karani Katsetsi paapaya patɨa.
Yarahi niwemama: Xekeni, Kutani, Ketsani, Pereti, 'Epa meta Tsakapi.
Mahaka, Karewi ti'uximayatsiriwame 'ɨyayatɨtɨ matɨa, Tsewexi mamaaya kanayani meta Tirikana,
metatsiere Tsakapi mamaaya kanayani, Marimana paapaya matɨa, metatsiere Maka Tsewa mamaaya patɨa, mɨkɨ Makiwena paapaya matɨa meta Kiweya. Metatsiere Karewi xeime 'uka kanayexeiya 'Akatsa titewakame.
Mɨkɨ mekanakɨne Karewi nuiwarimama. Kuxi niwemama, 'Epɨrata matɨarieya, mekanakɨne: Tsuwari, Kiriati-Yeharini paapaya matɨa,
Tsarima, Wereni paapaya, meta Karepi, Weti-Karexi paapaya matɨa.
Tsuwari niwemama, Kiriati-Yeharini paapaya, mekanakɨne: Haruhe, hixɨata me'atɨ manakatitsixi,
Kiriati-Yeharini tɨɨriyamama, 'itɨritatsixi, putitsixi, tsumatitsixi meta mitsirahitsixi, mɨkɨ wahetsie mepɨyekɨ tsuratitsixi meta 'etsitahuritsixi.
Tsarima niwemama: Wereni, netupatari, 'Ateruti-Weti-Kuhawi, hixɨata me'atɨ manakatitsixi, tsurehitsixi,
metatsiere te'utɨwamete Kawetsi memɨtamakai, mɨkɨ mepɨhɨkɨtɨkai, tirateutsixi, tsimateutsixi meta tsukatehutsixi. 'Ikɨ mepakɨ kenitsixi, Kamati nuiwarimama, Xekawi tɨɨriyamama wapaapa.
